description: Resolve up to 50 companies in one call. Every requested identifier appears in the result with an explicit status (resolved, not_found or invalid_organisation_number), so absence is never signalled by omission.

organisation_numbers.description: Swedish organisation numbers (10 or 12 digits), max 50

tier.description: Product tier. basic (free, fair-use limited): identity. verified (0.02 USDC/company): current state with per-value verification and provenance. intelligence (0.08 USDC/company): verified plus history, material events, annual-report financials, trends and deterministic signals. Paid tiers use x402 v2 on Base when payment is enforced: an unpaid call returns the PaymentRequired; retry with params._meta['x402/payment']. Omitted: basic while payment is enforced, the legacy untiered response in the free preview.

name: batch_get_companies
